channel.description: Latest articles from The London Free Press (lfpress.com)

item.title: A major bridge. 14 months of repairs. Lots of headaches for London drivers
item.description: A major rebuild of the Queen's Bridge, a key gateway connecting downtown London and the west end, is set to start next month

item.title: ANALYSIS: 'Tough year' looms after London region lost 5,000 jobs in a month
item.description: 'We're at the front edge of a wave. I don’t want to be doom-and-gloom but it will get worse before it gets better.'

item.title: At Ingersoll's high school, students revel in astronaut alum's moon shot
item.description: While walking through the halls of Ingersoll’s high school, it doesn't take long to find a display honouring the alumnus about to head to the moon.

item.title: Adventures on Wonderland closing, after one final March Break blast
item.description: A place filled with childhood memories for countless Londoners will close its doors in late March as its owner prepares to retire.

item.title: Burning cars, gunfire: Vacationing Londoner reflects on violence in Mexico
item.description: A Londoner vacationing in Puerto Vallarta says the situation is slowly calming after a chaotic Sunday.

item.title: Family calls time-served sentence in manslaughter case 'sickening'
item.description: The judge said that systemic factors reduced Koree Dockstater’s moral blameworthiness.

item.title: Charge laid after personal support worker sexually assaults hospital patient: Police
item.description: The patient notified hospital staff and police were contacted.

item.title: Police identify body, charge London man in death investigation
item.description: A 55-year-old man is charged with one count of improper or indecent interference with a dead body, police said.

item.title: Politicians back changes to London’s traffic calming process
item.description: Coun. Corrine Rahman’s motion calls for better communication with residents.

item.title: Hunter fined $3,000, loses licence after dogs killed during coyote hunt
item.description: One of the dogs’ owners said, “This is not justice.”
